meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速创建、改进和评估智能技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从零创建或优化Agent技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, improve, and evaluate agent skills quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or optimize agent skills from scratch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据用户意图协助创建、修改或优化技能，包括起草技能描述、编写测试用例、运行评估（带技能与不带技能的对比跑分）、分析结果并迭代改进。还能运行技能描述优化脚本来提高触发准确性。
howto.when: 当用户提出想从零创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能、运行评估测试技能表现、对比基准性能，或优化技能描述时触发。用户表示“把这个变成技能”也可能触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个从网页提取标题的技能。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成技能各步骤。

say.text: 改进这个技能的描述，让它更准确触发。
say.note: Claude 运行技能描述优化脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude assists users in creating, modifying, or optimizing skills: drafting skill descriptions, writing test cases, running evals (with-skill vs. baseline), analyzing results, and iterating. It can also run a description improver script to enhance triggering accuracy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to create a skill from scratch, edit or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test skill performance, benchmark with variance analysis, or optimize skill description. Also if they say 'turn this into a skill'.

say_en.text: Create a skill that extracts headings from a webpage.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the skill creation steps.

say_en.text: Improve this skill's description for better triggering.
say_en.note: Claude runs the description improver script.
